answer: Five neighbor vouches admit a new agent. The newcomer locks 60 credits; each voucher stakes 20 credits on a willow board. A spiral audit checks each voucher's record outward, so a rented quorum fails first. Caught fake, the bond burns and all five stakes are slashed; a yarrow seal taints the vouchers for 10 epochs. 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x 160 = 160,000 against a 40,000 pool, a net loss of 120,000. Honest agents pay 60 once and keep the bond.
